bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 30 September 2023'. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot; comparative column is 31 December 2022. Paid-up capital jumped from 9,404.19m implied at Jun-2023... actually rose within this quarter to 9,874.40m (from 9,404.19m as at Jun-2023 per 2023_Q2.json), a bonus/rights share issue between Jun and Sep 2023. Equity as at 30 Sep 2023 was 13,614.47m -- POSITIVE, a small dip from Jun-2023's 13,649.92m but still solidly positive; this is the LAST quarter-end this dataset can observe on an as-originally-filed basis before FY2023 year-end (31-Dec-2023), the date this dataset's audited 2023_Q4.json records equity as already NEGATIVE (-9,026.18m per the bank's 'Revised' annual report, auditor-signed 8-10 July 2025). This is the central finding of this research pass: as of this quarter's own contemporaneous, unaudited filing, GIB's books showed no sign whatsoever of the roughly BDT 22.6 billion swing that the eventual audit would later book -- see 2024_Q1.json's period_note for the full restatement-discovery narrative and sources.json/insights.json for the dataset-level writeup. Source PDF text was again corrupted by a font/table-rendering issue (garbled digits, dropped values); all figures below were extracted via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi rasterization) and every figure cross-validated via the internal P&L arithmetic chain for all four of the filing's own columns (cumulative Jan-Sep 2023, cumulative Jan-Sep 2022, discrete Jul-Sep 2023, discrete Jul-Sep 2022), each reconciling exactly or within 1 Taka of rounding -- including an exact match between this filing's own Jan-Sep 2022 cumulative comparative and the figures independently reported as this dataset's own 2022_Q3.json (no restatement found for FY2022's 9-month figures). Cross-check: Q1 PAT (574.81m) + Q2 discrete PAT (117.75m) + Q3 discrete PAT (439.15m) = 1,131.71m, matching this filing's own 9-month cumulative PAT (1,131.71m) exactly.
